nullable_fields: anchor and horizon fields when status=UNAVAILABLE
immediate impulse timestamps, peak fields, and retention when no directional impulse can be established
error_message unless status is UNAVAILABLE or INVALID
identity_rule: outcome_id = OUT_<sha256(episode_id, release_ts, contract_version)[:20]>. It is provider- and arm-independent; every Prediction for an Episode attaches to this one canonical Outcome.

price_anchor_rule.rule: Use the close of the latest accepted USD/JPY candle at or before release_ts. The timestamp is UTC and may be no more than 60 seconds stale; otherwise Outcome is UNAVAILABLE. This replaces v2.0's reaction-detected anchor because v2.1 evaluates the path from the scheduled catalyst release.
price_anchor_rule.market_closed: UNAVAILABLE; do not substitute a later opening price.

horizon_price_rule: For T+5, T+15, T+30, and T+60, use the close of an accepted candle timestamped at or before release_ts+horizon and no more than 60 seconds earlier. Persist all observation timestamps in source_lineage.horizon_observation_ts. Any missing or stale horizon makes the Outcome UNAVAILABLE; no fallback-to-last-candle is permitted.
pip_rule: realized_pips = round((horizon_price - anchor_price) / 0.01, 2). USD/JPY pips are signed; max_up_pips is non-negative and max_down_pips is non-positive.

directions.rule: abs(realized_pips) < 1.0 is FLAT; otherwise positive is UP and negative is DOWN.

branching.SUPPORTED: ordered sub-minute observations are sufficient to determine movement sequence and persistence
branching.APPROXIMATION_ONLY: one-minute ordered observations are available; the stored sidecar is explicitly approximate and must not claim tick-accurate sequencing
branching.UNAVAILABLE_UNSUPPORTED_RESOLUTION: only five-minute bars, endpoints, or otherwise insufficient resolution is available
branching.OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE: required market data could not be retrieved or does not cover the Episode
branching.INVALID_MARKET_DATA: timestamps, duplicates, or price lineage violate deterministic acceptance rules

t5_semantic_rule: direction_5m and pips_5m remain preserved fields but now represent EARLY_REACTION_5M, not the strict first move. They are evaluated relative to the same pre-release anchor as T+15.
excursion_rule: max_up_pips, max_down_pips, max_up_ts, and max_down_ts cover release_ts through T+60 minutes inclusive.
reversal_rule: initial_direction is direction_5m when directional, otherwise the first directional value at 15, 30, or 60 minutes, otherwise FLAT. reversal_flag is true when the earliest later required horizon is opposite to initial_direction; reversal_ts is exactly that release_ts plus horizon. No free-form reversal interpretation is allowed.
intervening_event_rule: true when another non-IGNORE Episode has release_ts strictly after this Episode and at or before T+60. It is flag-only in v1: all available horizons remain eligible and the flag is reported without automatic exclusion.
